Nadia Ortiz: Heads-up  starting to get inbound from EU trial customers: activations stuck at "indexing" and search returning partial results. I exported 101 affected tenants. Need a concise customer note + standard credit and a plan for renewal-risk accounts. :loudspeaker:

Caleb Morgan: Infra update: small downstream 5xx burst amplified by aggressive client retries; two indexer nodes hit JVM pauses which caused consumer lag. We applied a retry cap and increased consumer parallelism at 2767890900. ETA drain ~45m. No data loss observed.

Yuki Tanaka: Draft customer copy (short + multilingual note):

Yuki Tanaka: "Hi  apologies for the interruption. Some EU trials are experiencing slower onboarding and partial search while we clear an indexing backlog. Engineers have applied mitigations and we expect normal service within 1 hour.

What we9re doing: capped retries, scaled processing, and monitoring the queue. We will run targeted backfills for high-touch customers upon request.

Credits: impacted trials will receive a $225 account credit automatically. For renewal-risk accounts (> $20k ARR) we will follow up directly with a tailored remediation plan.

If you need help, book EU-friendly office hours: https://cal.redwood.ai/cs-eu-slots

We9ll send a full RCA after the incident.  Redwood Support"

Nadia Ortiz: Nice wording. Two operational asks: 1) standardize credit policy as $225 for trials <180 days; 2) attach short survey link after recovery to capture impact for renewals: https://survey.redwood.ai/impact.

Caleb Morgan: Deploy events: https://deploys.redwood.ai/roll/retry-cap-900  success @ 2767891505. Queue drain: 35% @15m, 76% @35m.

DeployBot: Roll/retry-cap-900 completed  5 instances updated  2767891505

CS Bot: Incident INC-5301 logged  affected=101  status=mitigated  office hours link attached.

Yuki Tanaka: Sending first wave to affected trials (in-app + email) now. Subject: "Update: temporary onboarding delays for some EU trials". Includes credit note, booking link, and a multilingual sentence offering follow-up in local language on request.

Caleb Morgan: Full drain confirmed at 2767892520. No corruption detected. We'll include GC tuning, consumer-lag alerting, and retry-logic changes in the postmortem.

Nadia Ortiz: Timeline: 1) first customer wave (sent) 2) status page update when drain=100% 3) RCA + renewal-risk comms within 24h 4) credits auto-applied + survey out within 48h. I'll DM the AE list for any accounts >$20k ARR. Thanks team. :pray:
